summary_1line: Gautama compels Indra to return his elephant and ascends to heaven; Bhishma then begins a discourse on supreme penance through Bhagiratha’s account of vast yet insufficient merits.

image_candidates.scene_text: The white elephant returns to Gautama, lowering its trunk to sniff the sage’s feet while Indra stands respectfully before him.
Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, leads Gautama and his beloved elephant upward toward the radiant gates of heaven.
Bhagiratha recounts immense sacrifices before Brahma, describing mountains of gold, countless cattle, and kings bound with golden garlands.
